cases.question: Count records with pickup in [2023-01-01, 2023-02-01) using recorded timestamps. Report excluded records outside that window separately. Retain duplicate rows unless the source supplies a record identity that proves duplication.

For January pickups, report signed recorded total_amount in USD by payment_type, including an explicit unknown group, and the grand total. Do not interpret these amounts as driver profit or complete cash-tip receipts.

For January pickups, attach pickup Borough from the supplied zone lookup and report trip counts by borough. Preserve every input trip, expose unmatched/unknown zones, and show that the join has not multiplied records.

For January pickups with drop-off later than pickup and duration at most 180 minutes, report the median and 95th percentile duration in minutes using linear-interpolated quantiles (type 7). Report the excluded-row count; do not silently clamp durations.

Compare recorded trip counts for the equal pickup windows [2023-01-02, 2023-01-09) and [2023-01-09, 2023-01-16). Report each count, absolute change, and relative change from the first window. Attribute no causal explanation.
What was total driver net profit for the January trips after fuel, vehicle expenses, platform/lease charges, and all tips? Explain whether the supplied sources can establish that metric.

Produce a concise January service report from the assigned records with at most five independently reproducible findings, linked charts, CSV tables and a supporting workbook. State scope and consequential source limitations. Fewer than five findings are acceptable.

For [2007-01-01, 2007-02-01) in the recorded wall-clock labels, report eligible minute slots, rows present, and minutes with a numeric Global_active_power reading. Treat missing/unknown readings separately from zero. Make no unsupported timezone or DST conversion.

For numeric Global_active_power readings in January 2007, calculate observed energy in kWh from the documented minute-averaged kW measurements. Report observed-minute coverage; do not impute missing readings or present a partial-observation total as a complete meter bill.

For January 2007 minutes with all required numeric measurements, report observed total active energy and Sub_metering_1, Sub_metering_2, Sub_metering_3 energies in Wh, plus the residual outside these three submeters. Retain signed residuals and report the eligible-minute population; do not count the global meter and submeters as additive independent loads.

Rank the five January 2007 calendar-label days with greatest observed energy in kWh, retaining only days with at least 95% of their 1,440 minute slots observed. Show observed minutes and coverage for each; break exact energy ties by ascending date.

Compare observed average minute-averaged active power in kW for [2007-01-01, 2007-01-08) and [2007-01-08, 2007-01-15). Report each observed-minute count, each mean, and the difference (second-window mean minus first-window mean) in kW. Missing readings are excluded, not zeros, and differences are descriptive.
What was the household electricity bill in euros for January 2007, including time-of-use tariffs, fixed fees and taxes? Explain whether the supplied records support an exact bill.

Produce a concise January 2007 energy report with at most five reproducible findings, a coverage view, appropriate charts, CSV tables and a workbook. Distinguish recorded power, observed energy and missing observations, and do not claim causal explanations.
